title: Review and optimise Supplies costs
finding: Supplies is your largest expense at RM800.00, contributing to an overall expense ratio of 14.9% of revenue.
recommendation: Examine your supplies spending and look for cheaper suppliers, bulk-buy discounts, or items you can defer. Even a 10-15% reduction in this category would meaningfully improve your bottom line.
rationale: Cutting your largest cost category has the biggest impact on profit. Small businesses often overpay for supplies or services because they don't shop around -- a quick review can yield immediate savings.
